newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver closes steeply lower, gold steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver closes steeply lower, gold steady.

text.p: Silver prices fell further by close on Wednesday after opening steeply lower, moving in the shadow of a subdued world trend while gold held steady, dealers said.
"Traders were active sellers today following a sharp fall in the cost of imported silver," said a dealer. India's silver requirements are met entirely by imports.
He said sluggish industrial demand had also depressed market sentiment.
Gold opened on a dull note but renewed festival enquiries ahead of Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights, trimmed the early losses towards close.
